text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The concert has come to an end, and the stage is all cleaned up.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Mission complete.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: Oh, Bourbon! You were so cool on stage!

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: Really, you were just so… so amazing, and… I'm going to work hard! Harder than I ever have!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Why are you crying?

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: Because your performance… was just so emotional.

text_block_list.name: Long-Haired Girl
text_block_list.text: I could feel your drive to be the best you can be!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
choice_data_list: Sounds like you conveyed your emotions.
Sounds like you conveyed your emotions.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Bourbon, your performance today was incredible!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: What new trick did you pick up? C'mon, spill the beans!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I executed the command "convey."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: My objective was to put feelings into my singing, just like I'd seen you do before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Do you think I succeeded?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you did! You succeeded big time!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right, FalFal Gauge powered up! We're just getting started, Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: We're gonna deliver joy and gratitude and ALL the bestest feelings to our fans! ☆

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Affirmative.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In addition to raising awareness, it looks like these concerts are helping the girls grow as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Pleased by this development, I turn my focus to thinking about our next steps, when…

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Hey, you hear what they said about the Grand Concert? Think we can join too?!

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: I dunno, but I need it! I want to sing so bad! You think they'll let us do "Next Frontier"? It'd be a dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Student C
text_block_list.text: A concert that anyone can perform in? I don't know about that…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I hear a chorus of impressions from the crowd.
